$comment: Metadata for each item. The build finds the files and the dependencies from the imports.

utils.title: Utils
utils.description: The cn() helper that merges Tailwind class names.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: The design tokens, the light and dark themes, and the base styles.

accordion.title: Accordion
accordion.description: Rows that each open on what they hold, ruled off from one another.

avatar.title: Avatar
avatar.description: A person or a place as a picture, or their initials in a colour of their own.

badge.title: Badge
badge.description: A short label in a colour: a state, a category, a count.

button.title: Button
button.description: A button with variants, sizes and a pending state.

checkbox.title: Checkbox
checkbox.description: A box to tick, with its label, for a yes or no and for a list of choices.

dialog.title: Dialog
dialog.description: A modal window over the page, with a title, a description and actions.

field.title: Field
field.description: A control with its label, a hint and its error, wired for assistive technology.

input.title: Input
input.description: A text field, in a box, in place or over a line.

menu.title: Menu
menu.description: A list of actions that opens from a button or a right click.

popover.title: Popover
popover.description: A small panel that opens from a button, for a few fields or a closer look.

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: How far a task that takes time has gone, or that it is still going.

radio-group.title: Radio Group
radio-group.description: One answer out of a few options, all of them in sight.

select.title: Select
select.description: A form field with one or more values from a list of options.

switch.title: Switch
switch.description: An on and off setting that takes effect at once, with its label.

tabs.title: Tabs
tabs.description: Sections of one place, one in view at a time, picked from a strip or a rail.

textarea.title: Textarea
textarea.description: A field for a few lines of text, growing with what is typed.

toggle.title: Toggle
toggle.description: A button that stays in when pressed, and out when pressed again.

toggle-group.title: Toggle Group
toggle-group.description: Toggles side by side, one of them in or several, reached by the arrow keys.

tooltip.title: Tooltip
tooltip.description: A short line that describes a control, under the pointer or the keyboard focus.
